name: AdGuard Home
author: NetMaster
description: Shows which sites each device looks up and what was blocked, alerts about malware sites, mining pools and random-looking domains, and lets you block or allow sites per device or for everyone. Works with AdGuard Home and its Home Assistant add-on.

settings.label: AdGuard Home address
settings.help: For example http://192.168.1.10:3000. For the Home Assistant add-on: https://<home-assistant-ip>:3000

settings.label: Username
settings.help: For the Home Assistant add-on: your Home Assistant login.

settings.label: Check the HTTPS certificate
settings.help: Turn off for the Home Assistant add-on, which uses its own certificate.
